description: Vendor, catalog model, thinking level and the vendor base URL rule (D6). Each vector applies `change` to `draft` (or creates the draft when both are null) and expects the new draft, its view and its submission. The policy only shortens the vendor list.

vectors.name: vendor fills adapter, auth mode and base URL
catalog model takes Pi's default level
new key makes the draft valid
model without the default level needs an explicit level
equivalent base URL keeps the catalog entry
another endpoint drops the catalog entry to manual
